summary: Kerb on a busy residential road where cars park, with houses about 12 m away.
reasons: Houses 12-19 m away on both sides
Wide road, near level at 60-80 m

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings line both sides, 12-19 m from the kerb, so neighbours would notice an overnight van.
drivers.access_and_room: Marked, wide road with parked cars along the kerb; room to stop clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road with lane markings and moving traffic; constant passing noise.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along the kerb in both images, so a van would not stand out much.

flags: Houses 10-25 m away on both sides
sun_shade: Mostly open kerb, with tree canopy shading patches on the north side; morning sun from the east.

best_section.where: Jerrang Street, north kerb, between the two houses just past the 50 m marker heading downhill
